evidence.title: Counterfactual Transition Graphs: Evaluating Cross-Class Transition Quality

summary: Researchers introduced Counterfactual Transition Graphs, a technique that visualizes and quantifies how AI systems move between output classes under counterfactual perturbations. The approach offers a more nuanced evaluation of model robustness and helps identify latent biases across class boundaries.
title: New Counterfactual Transition Graph Method Assesses Cross-Class Transition Quality in AI Models
